title: S3 - Connected rehabilitation workflow
description: Weeks 5-6. Exit: therapist assigns versioned prescriptions; patient completes an offline session; results synchronize once; server enforces patient boundaries.
goal: Connect therapist prescriptions to the complete patient exercise workflow.
entry_criteria: Confirm owners and realistic capacity before starting.
Required predecessor deliverables are available or scheduled in dependency order.

exit_criteria.description: All engineering implementation issues are solved with evidence; user-deferred checks remain unexecuted in the follow-up checklist.
Assign a prescription, finish the exercise offline, reconnect and show exactly one saved session to the authorized therapist.
exit_criteria.deferral_authority: User instruction: therapist/physical checks are deferred and implemented work/solved GitHub issues must be closed.
exit_criteria.disposition: Deferred physical/demo verification remains unexecuted; engineering delivery is evidenced separately.

demo: Assign a prescription, finish the exercise offline, reconnect and show exactly one saved session to the authorized therapist.
risks: Auth and prescription version contracts must be stable.
Exercise synchronization failures with lost server acknowledgements.

execution_plan.first_week: Work prerequisites first; review integration and measurement risks midweek.
execution_plan.second_week: Integrate, execute acceptance checks, fix defects and demonstrate the sprint outcome.
execution_plan.capacity_policy: Estimates are provisional; reserve approximately 20% of actual team capacity for integration and defects.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Build therapist patient management and access assignment
issues.description: Provide the therapist patient list, patient profile creation/linking and assigned-patient history entry point.

functions.name: RehabilitationViewModel.invite / SupabaseAuthRepository.invitePatient / invite_patient
functions.description: Create a seven-day email-bound invitation without a patient password.

functions.name: accept_patient_invitation / revoke_patient_link
functions.description: Accept matching-email links and revoke only the calling therapist's active patient access.

acceptance_criteria.description: Therapist can register/link a patient through an approved invitation flow without knowing their password.
Only authorized staff can create or revoke therapist-patient links.
Revoking a link prevents future server access; offline cache limitations and expiry behavior are explicit.
Loading, empty, validation and denied-access states are handled.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Implement exercise catalogue and versioned prescriptions
issues.description: Allow therapists to prescribe supported exercises with side, ROM targets, repetition target and applicable duration/form parameters.

functions.name: PrescriptionForm / publish_prescription
functions.description: Validate supported targets/timing/form rules and append immutable prescription versions using stable request UUIDs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Server validates parameters against the supported exercise schema.
Editing a prescription creates a new immutable version; historical sessions retain the original version.
Patients can read their active assignments but cannot change prescribed targets.
Add/change parameters for an existing supported algorithm without modifying pose-detection code.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Connect patient assignments to offline exercise sessions
issues.description: Complete the patient journey from assigned exercise to setup, live guidance and saved result.

functions.name: CachedAssignments / PrescriptionCache.decode
functions.description: Show cached instructions, pinned version, freshness and actionable expiry/unavailable states.

functions.name: ExerciseSessionViewModel.usePrescription / start
functions.description: Launch a selected cached prescription and persist consent before its first session checkpoint.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exercise list shows current prescription, instructions and last synchronization time.
Session pins the downloaded prescription version at start and retains it through completion.
An already signed-in user can complete a cached assignment offline, subject to the documented cache validity policy.
Exercise unavailable, expired assignment and missing model/instructions have actionable messages.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Implement retry-safe session synchronization
issues.description: Use WorkManager plus a validated transactional server operation to upload sessions and child measurements.

functions.name: SessionSync / SessionSyncWorker / SyncScheduler
functions.description: Drain durable owner-scoped consent/session outboxes with WorkManager constraints, protected auth and bounded backoff.

functions.name: ingest_session
functions.description: Validate ownership, pinned prescription and consent; commit parent/measurement atomically and acknowledge identical UUID/hash retries once.

acceptance_criteria.description: Retries and duplicate requests create exactly one session and one logical set of measurements.
Session and measurements commit atomically; patient ID and prescription ownership are validated server-side.
Offline, network timeout, expired token and process restart recover with visible pending/synced/failed states.
Conflicts preserve the prescription used during recording and do not overwrite newer therapist settings.
Backoff, auth-required errors and permanently rejected writes have bounded, documented recovery behavior.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Implement consent records, retention and audit events
issues.description: Record consent version and key changes while implementing approved data retention and patient withdrawal workflows.

functions.name: SessionStore.recordConsent / record_consent
functions.description: Persist chronological grant/withdrawal evidence independently of camera permission.

functions.name: request_patient_data / audit_workflow_change
functions.description: Track export/deletion requests and audit trusted role/link/prescription/request changes under the documented development retention policy.

acceptance_criteria.description: Consent is recorded before collecting session data; camera permission alone is insufficient.
Audit logs capture role/link/prescription changes and authorized record actions without raw tokens or unnecessary health details.
Define retention periods, deletion/export request handling and backup-retention implications with the project owner.
acceptance_criteria.disposition: Deferred follow-up; does not block development delivery
acceptance_criteria.deferral_authority: User instruction: therapist/physical checks are deferred and implemented work/solved GitHub issues must be closed.

acceptance_criteria.description: Camera frames stay in memory by default; logs and analytics do not upload raw video or identifiable pose traces.

completion.reviewed_by: Codex engineering evidence review (not clinical approval)

issues.title: Test authorization boundaries and offline synchronization end to end
issues.description: Validate the complete therapist-to-patient workflow and database boundaries using synthetic records.

functions.name: test_connected_workflow.py
functions.description: Run real Auth/PostgREST access, invitation, prescription, consent, atomicity and idempotency checks with four disposable users.

functions.name: ConnectedPersistenceTest / ConnectedRepositoryTest / verify_backend_migrations.py
functions.description: Verify offline/lost-response/restart recovery, migration, protected auth, owner boundaries and fresh application-schema replay.

acceptance_criteria.description: Two patients and two therapists prove cross-patient isolation through direct API requests, not just hidden UI controls.
Airplane mode, dropped responses after commit and repeated retry produce no duplicate/lost completed sessions.
acceptance_criteria.disposition: Offline/lost-response/file-reopen paths verified automatically; actual airplane-mode device demonstration is a deferred follow-up, not a development blocker
acceptance_criteria.deferral_authority: User instruction: therapist/physical checks are deferred and implemented work/solved GitHub issues must be closed.

acceptance_criteria.description: Role tampering, prescription tampering and child-table access are rejected.
Record reproducible test evidence and link defects to the release checklist.
